description: This file contains platform-specific upgrade and verification functions for the i.MX processors in the OpenWrt project. It defines functions to check image compatibility, perform upgrades, copy configurations, and prepare for upgrade, primarily distinguished by board names and specific hardware identifiers.

methods.name: enable_image_metadata_check
methods.description: Enables image metadata check for certain board configurations based on board name

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks whether the current image is compatible with the board identified by board_name()

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the upgrade process tailored to the identified board

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies necessary configuration files to the proper locations before upgrade

methods.name: platform_pre_upgrade
methods.description: Prepares the system for upgrade, performing any necessary pre-upgrade tasks
